artworks.title: Confrère, méfiez-vous du petit baron...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two stout male figures wearing formal attire: long coats and top hats. They face each other, with one extending a hand. The figures are drawn with bold lines and their clothing features large patterns of lines and checkers. Their expressions and body language imply communication or interaction. The background is a textured shading that emphasizes the figures. The drawing style is reminiscent of caricature sketches, capturing a humorous or critical depiction of the characters.

artworks.title: Albrecht Altdorfer
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a calm expression, a long beard and mustache, and is wearing a cap with a band. His clothing appears formal with fur trim. The background is a simple, lined texture with a circular frame. The name 'ALBERTUS ALTOR FFERUS' appears at the top, and 'Philippum Kilian f.' at the bottom.

artworks.title: Large Spaniard (Le grand Espagnol)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a bust of an older man portrayed from the waist up, in a seated position and turned slightly to his right. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, high cheekbones, and a serious expression. His hair is short, tousled, and receding. He is dressed in a buttoned vest and a cloak draped over his shoulders. The man is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain, directing focus to the man's portrait.

artworks.title: Collège Henri IV, Paris, ou Lycée Napoléon (Henry IV College or Napoleon School, Paris)
artworks.description: The image is an intricate etching of an urban landscape, viewed from an elevated, bird's-eye perspective. The scene shows a sprawling cityscape with various buildings, rooftops, streets, and figures. One prominent structure is detailed with architectural elements and surrounded by courtyards and pathways lined with trees. The rest of the city consists of tightly packed buildings in rectangular and square shapes, with pitched roofs creating a rhythmic pattern. The etching features fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and uses a monochromatic color palette of black, brown, and cream to convey depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Les trois cochons couchés devant l'étable (Three Swine Lying In Front of a Sty)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene from an elevated point of view, capturing animals and a shelter. The horizon is low with trees, bushes, a cloudy sky, distinct brushstrokes, detailed textures, three resting pigs in the foreground, a simple shelter with a thatched roof behind them, and a sepia color palette creating a warm, vintage feel.

artworks.title: The Little Jewish Bride (Saskia as Saint Catherine)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a relaxed position, facing the viewer. Their facial features include a rounded face with small eyebrows and a closed-lip expression. They have long curly hair with a band or ribbon. The person is wearing a loose, flowing garment and their hands are clasped in front. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: The Fore Chains
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching portraying a tall ship with expansive sails catching the wind. The perspective is from below, emphasizing the height and scale of the vessel's mast and rigging against a backdrop of churning waves. The style features detailed lines depicting the ropes and sails, with expressive brushstrokes creating texture and movement. The ocean is depicted with swirling waves, conveying energy and action. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white to highlight the ship's structure and the sea.

artworks.title: The Manager's Window, Gaiety Theatre
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated perspective. The focus is on a large two-story building with ornate windows and foliage on the ledges. Objects diminish in size towards the distance, creating depth. The painting style features sketchy brushstrokes, giving a loose and expressive look. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray on a beige canvas, emphasizing details and textures. People are seen conversing or walking, adding dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Prudencia (Prudence)
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure in profile, walking to the right. The figure is holding a circular object in their right hand while the left hand holds the edge of their draped garment. The facial features include a straight nose and a closed mouth with hair tied back, crowned with a laurel wreath. The attire consists of a classical-style robe with draped folds, revealing part of a leg. The figure has feathered wings emerging from the back. In the background, there is a patterned surface on the ground, and to the side, a large compass or divider is placed beside a square block. The scene includes the inscription "PRUDENCIA" along the right side, and the letters "HSB" appear in the upper left corner, along with the numeral "2."

artworks.title: Charitas (Charity)
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure with wings and cherubim. The adult figure holds a winged cherub across their chest while another cherub reaches toward them from below. The adult figure has defined facial features, elaborate hair, and wears long robes cinched at the waist. Two cherubs and a small dog surround the main figure. The background is neutral with minimal details, and the text "CHARITAS" and an "ISB" monogram is included in the image.

artworks.title: Justicia (Justice)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure holding a sword and scales. The figure has large, feathered wings and is dressed in a draped garment with a delicate pattern. The text "IVSTICIA" is inscribed above, and there is a number "4" in the corner. Below the figure are objects like a ceramic jug and a round object, possibly representing weights.

artworks.title: Spes (Hope)
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure reaching towards a light source. The figure has raised arms and closed eyes, with a headband and flowing cloth covering the lower body. A metal ring with a chain and the word "SPES" is shown on the left. In the background, a male figure with curly hair and a beard is observing the scene. The backdrop is textured with engraved details.

artworks.title: Fortitudo (Fortitude)
artworks.description: The image shows a winged figure leaning on a column with the word "FORTITUDO" inscribed upon it. The figure has a calm expression, short curly hair with a laurel wreath, and is draped around the lower body. The figure is holding a broken column, with a lion's head behind it. The background is a simple, lightly shaded surface.

artworks.title: Temperancia (Temperance)
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body figure standing in a slight profile position. The figure has a classic profile facial feature with a well-defined nose and a serene expression. The hair is styled with curls and adorned with a headpiece or wreath. Draped clothing falls elegantly down to the ankles, with a sense of motion in the fabric's folds. Large feathered wings extend from the figure's back. They are holding a jug-like vessel in one hand, pouring liquid onto a ball beneath, while their other arm is bent upward, clutching another vessel. The background has a textured surface with geometric patterns resembling stair steps or a podium. The left side of the image has the word "TEMPERANCIA" along its length, and the inscription "I-SB 1539" is visible on the right.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Couple of Tritons Blowing Horns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged creatures playing musical instruments. Each figure has animalistic legs and is seated next to an ornate vase. They are blowing into curved horn-like instruments. The background is filled with intricate scrollwork and floral motifs, complementing the overall decorative style of the drawing.

artworks.title: Ornament with Armour and Two Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two winged cherubs holding a headless armor piece surrounded by swirling foliage. The image features two cherubic figures on either side of a central element, which is a torso encased in ornate armor that is lacking a head. Curved lines and floral motifs extend outward from the armor. The cherubs have plump features and small wings. The detailed cross-hatching and shading suggest a classical inspiration, resonating with the styles of the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Capital and Base of a Column
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural column capital with detailed ornamentation. The image depicts a column capital with acanthus leaves and classical scrolls, atop a fluted shaft with cracks and missing segments. Fine detailing is present throughout the drawing, showing attention to textures and patterns. The drawing is surrounded by text that appears to be notes or annotations about the design.

artworks.title: Capital and Base of a Column
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural column capital. The image is a detailed illustration of a classical Doric column capital, featuring intricate decorative elements such as scrolls and leaf motifs. The capital includes a human face motif at the center, flanked by elaborate swirling volutes. The drawing displays fine lines and shading techniques that emphasize the textural details of the stonework. Text in an old-style serif font is presented around the image, likely referring to Vitruvius, an ancient Roman architect. The year 1545 is inscribed at the top, along with additional text in another language, adding an academic or historical context to the artwork.

artworks.title: Antony Thouret
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of a man standing with his hands in his pockets. He is depicted with broad shoulders, a prominent belly, a large round face with a furrowed brow and a goatee. He has short, dark, somewhat unkempt hair and is dressed in a dark jacket, trousers, and shirt. The background is a light, textured surface with no distinct elements visible around him.

artworks.title: Jean Charles Besnard
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man in profile, standing with his hands in his pockets, looking towards a display window. His facial features are exaggerated, with a pronounced nose and a serious expression. He has curly hair peeking out from under a tall top hat. The man is wearing a dark jacket, patterned checkered trousers, and a bow tie. The background shows a shop window displaying several pastries or cakes, with the word "PASTEL" visible on the glass. The drawing is in black and white, with intricate shading.

artworks.title: A. Fréd. Pierre comte de Falloux
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his head slightly bowed and hands clasped together in front of him. He has exaggerated facial features, a full beard, and closed eyes. He wears a long robe and a skullcap, with wavy hair. Behind him, there is a crowd of people sketched in a more abstract style with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Eus. Isidore Buvignier
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man seated on a patterned upholstered bench. He is depicted from mid-thigh upwards with his legs crossed and arms resting on his legs. The man has exaggerated facial features including an elongated nose, large round eyes, and a broad mustache. He has short hair and appears to be wearing a dark jacket and patterned trousers. The background is blank except for the texture of the bench.

artworks.title: F.J. Ducoux
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man standing upright. The man has exaggerated facial features, a large, rounded face with a prominent chin, defined eyebrows, and a pursed lips expression. His short, wavy hair is neatly styled. He is dressed in formal attire - a dark jacket, a white shirt, bow tie, and light-toned pants. The man's left hand rests on a pedestal-like surface, while his right hand is on his hip. The background is plain with shading for depth.

artworks.title: Jean-Louis Greppo
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a man with exaggerated features. He is standing facing slightly to the right, with a long face, large nose, intense gaze, full beard, and short hair. He is dressed in a checkered suit and has his hands in his pockets. In the background, there are other vague figures, a seated person, and a gesturing figure on a platform. The background is lightly sketched with architectural and human elements in a whimsical, cartoonish style.
